payload.core_composition_summary: Greedy algorithm computes optimal replacements for each target digit; sorting resolves ties by lexicographic order.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy exchange argument to select closest digits for replacement, then sorts the resulting strings to pick the lexicographically smallest among those with minimal cost.
